$comment: Files install.sh installs into app/ and how upgrades treat them. Each entry is a flat object (no arrays) so install.sh can read it without jq. policy: replace = installer internals, always overwritten by the shipped version (a locally modified copy is saved next to it as <path>.local and in the upgrade backup); keep-modified = if the installed copy differs from every known shipped version (the checksum recorded at the last install in app/.managed-files.sha256, or one of known_sha256, space-separated), it is kept and the shipped version is written next to it as <path>.new; merge = .env, add-only merge driven by deploy/env.schema.json; user = never touched, carried over unchanged. legacy_path = where an older release kept the file; it is migrated from there. known_sha256 lists earlier shipped versions (LF line endings) that count as unmodified. install.sh downloads this file first and installs the replace and keep-modified entries it lists; RUNTIME_FILES in install.sh is only the fallback for older layouts and must stay in sync (scripts/test-install checks it).

files.description: Default deployment: only the vaultdock service. Customise it in docker-compose.override.yml; a locally edited copy is kept and the shipped version is written as docker-compose.yml.new.
Opt-in Caddy reverse proxy (VAULTDOCK_INTEGRATIONS=caddy). Same volumes as the former bundled caddy profile.
Caddy configuration for the caddy integration.
Read-only detection of an existing cloudflared (systemd, snap, Docker, process), used by install.sh integrations.
Opt-in: join VaultDock to the Docker network of an existing cloudflared (VAULTDOCK_INTEGRATIONS=cloudflared-net, VAULTDOCK_TUNNEL_NETWORK).
Configuration. Existing values are never changed; missing variables are appended; obsolete ones are removed only with per-variable approval.
Your own compose changes (extra disks, labels).
Optional: obsolete variable names approved for removal from .env, one per line.
